title: Step-by-Step Guide: How to Build an Emergency Fund
content: Building an emergency fund requires a systematic approach: 1. Calculate essential monthly baseline living expenses (rent, groceries, basic utilities, mandatory insurance, minimum debt EMIs). 2. Set an initial goal of 3 months expenses, expanding to 6 months for single-income households or freelancers. 3. Set up an automated monthly transfer into a separate high-yield liquid account. 4. Reserve this fund exclusively for genuine unexpected emergencies.
